standard_prerequisites.name: Conjunction elimination and introduction axioms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Propositional-logic part, axioms ax:land1 (twice, one per projection) and ax:land3 (pairing)
standard_prerequisites.use: Lines 1054 and 1056-1057: item (1) is 'modus ponens' on land1, item (2) 'two applications of modus ponens' on land3.

core_obligations: Item (1) (proof lines 1053-1055): each projection A and B |- A and A and B |- B is the axiom A and B -> A instantiated and modus ponens'd against the hypotheses.
Item (2) (lines 1056-1057): from ax:land3, A -> (B -> (A and B)), two successive modus ponens with the separate derivations of A and B fuse the pair.
proof_roadmap: Instantiate the elimination axiom on the conjunctive assumption.
Chain the introduction axiom through both hypotheses.

The left/right sub-labels are struck inside the statement (provability-land-left, provability-land-right) so downstream parts can cite the halves; the span carries both. H2: definitional axiom applications, fully written at the same depth the author chose.
